result.stdout:
RazorFormatter CLI
Usage: dotnet run --project src/RazorFormatter.Cli -- [options] <files/folders...>

Options:
  --server                    Run as a long-running JSON-RPC formatting daemon
  --changes-json              Output minimal text edits and diagnostics as JSON
  -w, --write                 Format and overwrite files in-place
  -c, --check                 Check if files are formatted (exits with code 1 if not)
      --tab                   Use tabs for indentation (default: spaces)
      --indent <n>            Number of spaces per indentation level (default: 4)
      --lf                    Force LF line endings
      --crlf                  Force CRLF line endings
      --attribute-layout <l>  Attribute layout: preserve, one-per-line, single-line
      --config <path>         Path to explicit .editorconfig file
      --ignore <pattern>      Glob pattern to ignore (can be used multiple times)
  -h, --help                  Show help
